why: After reply.hijack() Fastify's error handler cannot answer; a throw leaves the socket open forever. Wrap what follows in try/catch that ends the raw response.
bad:
reply.hijack();
const stop = await streamChanges(raw, session._id);
good:
reply.hijack();
try { await streamChanges(raw, session._id); } catch (err: unknown) { log.error({ err }, 'sse failed'); raw.end(); }
